channel.title: Spreadsheet Diary
channel.description: Real spreadsheet problems and how to solve them.

item.title: How to Calculate Percent Change in Excel (and Avoid #DIV/0!)
item.description: The percent change formula in Excel and Google Sheets, how to show it as a percentage, handle a zero starting value, and find a share of a total.

item.title: SUMIF vs SUMIFS, How to Sum With One or More Conditions
item.description: How SUMIF and SUMIFS add only the rows you want, why their argument order differs, and how to sum by date range, person, and channel.

item.title: Cleaning Up a Messy Sales Sheet
item.description: A step-by-step method for finding and removing duplicate rows and extra spaces in a sales spreadsheet, based on official Excel documentation.

item.title: Date Formulas for Deadlines and Workdays
item.description: How DATEDIF, NETWORKDAYS, and EDATE work in Excel, with each official example re-checked against a plain Python date calculation.

item.title: VLOOKUP vs XLOOKUP, Which Should You Use?
item.description: A side-by-side comparison of VLOOKUP and XLOOKUP in Excel, with a worked table example, based on official Microsoft function documentation.

item.title: Your First Pivot Table, Explained
item.description: A beginner walkthrough of what a pivot table does and how to build one in Excel or Google Sheets, based on official Microsoft and Google documentation.
